title: versions.json
description: Per-skill content provenance for consumers that mirror catalog skills. Generated by .github/scripts/generate_versions.py from committed catalog state.

skills.description: Every published skill, sorted by name.

name.description: Catalog directory name, unique across the catalog.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the skill directory.

content_digest.description: Digest over the skill's signed file list. Changes if and only if published content changes. Compare against a previously mirrored value to detect updates.

last_commit.description: Most recent catalog commit touching this skill directory.

last_modified.description: Commit date of last_commit, ISO 8601 date.
